department.instructions: Which department should handle this request?

criteria.billing: invoices, payment issues, subscription refunds, credit card charges
criteria.technical: system errors, bugs, outages, crashes, API failures
criteria.sales: enterprise quotes, pricing inquiry, new customer contracts, upgrades

urgency.instructions: How urgent is this customer request?
criteria: not urgent: casual feedback or general question
normal: standard request with no immediate deadline
critical: service outage, financial loss, or blocking production issue

churn_risk.instructions: Does the user threaten to cancel, switch to a competitor, or leave?
